usage: icebath backup [-h] [-o OUTPUT] [-q] [-l LABEL] [-k N]

Create a zip archive of your entire Icebath configuration, skills, sessions, and data (excludes
the icebath-agent codebase). Use --quick for a fast snapshot of just critical state files.

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  -o, --output OUTPUT  Output path for the zip file (default: ~/icebath-backup-<timestamp>.zip)
  -q, --quick          Quick snapshot: only critical state files (config, state.db, .env, auth,
                       cron)
  -l, --label LABEL    Label for the snapshot (only used with --quick)
  -k, --keep N         After a full backup, delete older icebath-backup-*.zip files in the output
                       directory beyond the newest N (default 3; 0 keeps everything)
